prompts.name: stain-a
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one production-ready isolated hand-painted ink/watercolor paint-splash opacity sprite for the Korean cooperative game Hapio.
Derive a fresh splash variation from reference image 1 (existing in-game irregular gourd paint footprint); use reference image 2 only for the soft mottled pigment and broken wet edge style. The gourd, rope, paper and scene are NOT part of the output.
STRICT deliverable: ONE isolated flat top-down paint stain, real transparent background, no solid backdrop or checkerboard, square canvas, generous 12% transparent margin, no text/labels/border. Paint is neutral WHITE; varying density, lighter wash, darker pooled-looking edges and tiny paper-like gaps must be conveyed as varying OPACITY against transparency, with neutral near-white RGB rather than any colored pigment. This will be alpha-tinted to five game colors. Preserve translucent areas; avoid an opaque plastic sticker. The silhouette must read at 24 to 48 screen pixels. Keep a strong dense joined main body with broad soft organic irregular lobes, a few visible bleed details and very few separate larger splatter beads. Do not use a teardrop, a water icon, black outline, 3D shading, bevel, shine, glow, smoke, flame, ornamental brush swirls, spiky starburst, hairlike tendrils, noisy pepper-speck halo, scattered field of tiny dots, or a perfectly round disc. All pigment is a flat surface stain, not falling water.
PRIMARY STAIN A: compact asymmetrical puddle with five broad rounded lobes, a slightly denser wet rim, a softly mottled central fill, and two nearby satellite beads. The body should be cohesive and plump, not a radial star.

revision_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied transparent sprite into a SECOND tiny satellite-spatter group for the same game art family. Keep exactly THREE separate small flat watercolor/ink spots in a compact central group: two squat oval flecks and one round smaller bead. Preserve the soft wet pooling and neutral near-white pigment. Spread the group into a shallow triangle, with clear transparent gaps between all three. The ENTIRE group occupies only the middle 28 percent of the square; the rest is genuine transparent alpha. These are secondary small specks, not a large stain. Do not introduce a connected main puddle, any starburst, a giant splash, lines, a teardrop, text, borders or a background. Preserve transparency. Local values should include translucent density and soft dry pores rather than a uniform solid sticker. No black contour. This is an isolated top-down surface paint texture.
alpha_contract: Generated RGBA is preserved. Preview uses source alpha once for silhouette and source neutral RGB for wash texture; game integration is pending.
